stockfish.note: Do not copy the Windows executable to the Mac. Install the macOS build of the same release (arm64 on Apple Silicon). The Mac SHA-256 will differ: that is expected provenance, not corruption. Historical label manifests keep the Windows hash; new labels record the Mac hash.

secrets.name: (none required)
secrets.note: No credential, token or key is read by any engine, tool or research script. GitHub access uses the user's own git credential helper on each machine.

components.note: Carries the local commits that are not on GitHub. Transfer as files; a clone of origin/main would lose them.
